title: Autopay Tenure Courtesy on Vehicle Permits — Community Rules & Site Care Resident Terms
content:
A resident whose Home-Site Lease is enrolled in autopay receives a permit courtesy reduction on the monthly vehicle permit fee of their Community Rules & Site Care plan record, by tenure counted in whole calendar months from the lease move-in date to the handling date:

- with at least 180 months of tenure, the reduction is 25% of the fee;
- with at least 84 months but fewer than 180 months of tenure, the reduction is 10% of the fee;
- a resident whose lease is not enrolled in autopay, or who has fewer than 84 months of tenure, receives no reduction.

The reduction is taken once, from the month's fee as it stands with the permit charge and every per-permit surcharge added together, and the reduced fee is rounded half up to the cent. The autopay enrollment and the move-in date are read from the Home-Site Lease.

## Truth table

| Home-Site Lease enrolled in autopay | Tenure in whole calendar months | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 180 or more | 25% |
| yes | 84 to 179 | 10% |
| yes | fewer than 84 | none |
| no | any | none |

## Tenure on both sides of a threshold

A hypothetical lease with a move-in date of 15 March 2019 shows 83 whole calendar months on 14 March 2026 and 84 on 15 March 2026. With autopay, the first date carries no reduction and the second carries 10%. Likewise 179 months carries 10% and 180 months 25%.

## Worked cases (hypothetical amounts)

| Fee before the reduction | Autopay and tenure | Reduction | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| $47.00 | autopay, 200 months | 25%, $11.75 | $35.25 |
| $47.00 | autopay, 90 months | 10%, $4.70 | $42.30 |
| $33.35 | autopay, 100 months | 10%, $3.335 | $30.015, rounded half up to $30.02 |
| $47.00 | no autopay, 200 months | none | $47.00 |
